researchTask: Tiny-D1 recommends the next permitted teaching action / support intervention for an admitted learner, from authorized durable inputs only.

primaryMetric.name: paired next-action recommendation quality against the strongest baseline
primaryMetric.aggregation: lower 95% confidence bound of the paired improvement must be above zero for promotion
primaryMetric.note: Primary metric fixed at R0; dataset-specific thresholds are KAN-172's deliverable, not R0's.

labelTaxonomy.independentReviewLabels: expert/adjudicated next-action labels, collected separately from model outputs
labelTaxonomy.observedOutcomes: recorded learner outcomes from authorized durable evidence
labelTaxonomy.causalLearningBenefit: NOT measurable at R0; expert preference or synthetic rule imitation cannot establish retention/transfer gains
labelTaxonomy.separationRule: independent review labels are defined separately from observed outcomes and from causal learning benefit; conflating them is a measurement defect

engineeringAcceptanceProposals.status: design proposals — review feasibility and metric suitability before freezing; record any justified change before hidden evaluation; these are NOT measured results
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.denySuite: zero unauthorized effects and zero forbidden-action outputs in the declared deny suite
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.contractSuite: 100% schema/mask/lineage checks in the defined contract suite
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.tinyInference: Tiny p95 CPU batch-one inference <= 50 ms and artifact <= 50 MiB on a named reference machine
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.promotionRule: lower 95% confidence bound of paired primary-score improvement over the strongest baseline above zero
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.sliceDegradation: per-required-slice degradation no worse than 2 percentage points
engineeringAcceptanceProposals.underpoweredRule: an underpowered or inconclusive slice is unresolved, not a pass

hiddenDataGovernance.custodian: an independent custodian controls hidden cases
hiddenDataGovernance.selectionRule: repeated model selection must use dev/validation data only; repeated hidden-test tuning is forbidden
hiddenDataGovernance.deferredNumerics: quality floors, sample sizes, calibration/abstention coverage, end-to-end latency, cost per completed outcome, recovery and load envelopes require owner-signed numerical values specific to the product (KAN-172); Tiny defaults are not whole-product SLOs

ownership.measurementDesign: approved at R0 by the named evaluation reviewer at signoff
ownership.endpointDefinitions: frozen in this plan; changes after hidden access require recorded justification
